'''Distillates''' are {{Rare}} items used to craft {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob Drops ===
'''Distillates''' are obtained as a {{Odds|r}} drop from {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}} {{SlayerTier|II}}+ with at least {{Coll|Blaze Slayer III}}. The amount dropped varies depending on the tier of the boss killed.

{{Item|Gabagool Distillate}} has the following drop chances:
{| class="wikitable ct"
|-
! Slayer Tier !! Amount !!  Drop Chance
|-
| {{Stier|2}} || 2 || {{Green|5.19%}}
|-
| {{Stier|3}} || 6-10 || {{Green|4.87%}}
|-
| {{Stier|4}} || 16-24 || {{Green|4.43%}}
|}
{{Item|Magma Cream Distillate}}, {{Item|Blaze Rod Distillate}}, {{Item|Nether Wart Distillate}}, and {{Item|Glowstone Distillate}} can only be dropped from [[Loot Sharing]] with {{More Info Needed}} chance.

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
'''Distillates''' are used to craft {{Item|Inferno Minion Fuel}}.
<tabber>
|-| Magma Cream Distillate = {{Crafting Usage|Magma Cream Distillate}}
|-| Blaze Rod Distillate = {{Crafting Usage|Blaze Rod Distillate}}
|-| Nether Wart Distillate = {{Crafting Usage|Nether Wart Distillate}}
|-| Glowstone Distillate = {{Crafting Usage|Glowstone Distillate}}
|-| Gabagool Distillate = {{Crafting Usage|Gabagool Distillate}}
</tabber>

== Bugs ==
*'''Distillates''' other than {{Item|Gabagool Distillate}} can currently only be obtained by [[loot sharing]] a boss.
